messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the major statutory holidays that typically create long‑weekend opportunities across Canada in 2023. (Note that some holidays are observed only in specific provinces or territories.)

| Date | Holiday | Notes |
|------|---------|-------|
| **January 1** | New Year’s Day | Federal holiday; falls on Sunday – many people take Monday off. |
| **February 20** | Family Day (Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Falls on Monday – creates a long weekend in those provinces. |
| **March 31** | St. Patrick’s Day (Ontario) | Observed in Ontario; falls on Monday. |
| **April 7** | Good Friday | Falls on Friday – often combined with Easter Monday (a bank holiday in some provinces). |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Falls on Monday – a federal holiday; creates a long weekend nationwide. |
| **June 19** | National Indigenous Peoples Day (Northwest Territories, Nunavut) | Falls on Monday – long weekend in those territories. |
| **July 1** | Canada Day | Falls on Saturday – many people take Monday off. |
| **September 4** | Labour Day | Falls on Monday – a federal holiday; long weekend nationwide. |
| **October 9** | Thanksgiving | Falls on Monday – a federal holiday; long weekend nationwide. |
| **November 11** | Remembrance Day | Falls on Thursday – many people take Friday off. |
| **December 25** | Christmas Day | Falls on Monday – long weekend. |
| **December 26** | Boxing Day (Canada Day) | Falls on Tuesday – often taken as a day off in some provinces. |

If you’re targeting a particular province or territory, let me know and I can narrow the list down to the holidays that apply there.
